notes: The ASV compresses Ἔγειρε εἰς τὸ μέσον into *Stand forth*; the accepted split gives *Stand* to the imperative and makes εἰς/μέσον one noncompositional unit under rules 45 and 94, with τό unrepresented under rule 93. The competing reading, *Stand forth* whole on Ἔγειρε, is named in the unit note.
τὴν χεῖρα → *his hand* takes the possessive on the article under rule 20's second arm; the second attributive τῷ is unrepresented under rules 23 and 31, the participle carrying the relativizer.
